Professional Summary
Backend-focused developer with experience building scalable Node.js services, APIs and data-backed features. Proven track record delivering production services using TypeScript, containerization and cloud infrastructure. Comfortable driving end-to-end delivery from design through deployment and monitoring.

Technical Skills
Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, RDS, S3, EC2, GraphQL, Redis, Docker, Linux

- Containerized multiple backend services with Docker and deployed them to EC2-based clusters; introduced health checks and rolling restarts to achieve zero-downtime releases.
- Built Redis-backed caching for product availability and cart sessions, cutting average API latency for read-heavy endpoints by 60% and lowering DB read load during peak periods.

Backend Engineer, Nykaa (Jun 2020 - Jan 2023)
- Developed TypeScript-based GraphQL resolvers and schema for the catalog and inventory domain, enabling unified queries and reducing frontend integration work by 40%.
- Implemented background jobs and asynchronous processing on Node.js for order enrichment and fulfillment notifications, integrating with S3 for artifact storage and RDS for transactional data.
- Migrated several legacy endpoints into containerized services and automated deployments on AWS EC2; added monitoring and alerts to improve incident response time.

Backend Engineer, Capgemini (Dec 2019 - May 2020)
- Built and maintained TypeScript services wrapped in Docker containers for enterprise clients, standardizing logging and error-handling practices across projects.
- Collaborated on API design and integration tests running on Linux CI runners, improving deployment reliability and reducing rollbacks.
- Assisted with capacity planning and tuning of containerized services to meet SLAs for peak loads.
